title: Telegram Bot Workers
why: The house recipe behind a working fleet of Telegram bots (channel AI, admin publisher, market poster, prompt optimizer). Every other bot skill out there assumes Python or a framework; this one covers the raw-API-on-Workers pattern those bots actually run on.
